title: WHERE DO WE PREPARE FIRST?
detail: The hours before landfall shape local decisions.
voice: Before a cyclone reaches Bangladesh, response teams face an urgent question. Which communities should prepare first?

title: GHURNI
detail: A cyclone decision-support prototype for Bangladesh.
voice: District officers and volunteers need time to brief teams and coordinate local support.

title: A TRACK IS ONLY THE START.
detail: Which communities? How many people? How uncertain?
voice: Cyclone-prone coasts around the world face the same gap. A track shows where the storm may go. Local teams still have to work out where damaging winds might reach.

title: KEEP THE UNCERTAINTY.
detail: Archived Remal forecast · 50 plausible tracks in one cycle
voice: Ghoorni brings live monitoring and historical impact analysis into one workspace. Teams can check the latest reported storm position, then use archived ensembles to explore how uncertainty changes local priorities.

title: MAKE THE IMPACT LOCAL.
detail: Forecast paths → wind simulation → union-level exposure
voice: We run each archived forecast through a physical wind model, then combine it with population data. This turns a set of storm tracks into local wind probabilities and estimated exposure ranges.

title: CHECK THE LATEST FIX.
detail: Cyclone position, model weather, and data freshness.
voice: In Live mode, the map combines storm fixes with model winds. Here the feed is connected, but the last reported fix is old. Ghoorni flags it and pauses the nowcast.

title: SEE WHAT MAY FOLLOW.
detail: Provider forecast track and regional weather.
voice: Forecast mode shows the provider’s track and uncertainty cone when available. Regional weather frames extend through day five. Missing intensity stays blank.

title: 5,160 UNIONS.
detail: Search a community, then compare forecast cycles.
voice: Switch to Historical and replay Cyclone Remal. Search for Amadi and check its wind probability. Compare the three forecast cycles to see how its risk changes.

title: ACT. PREPARE. MONITOR.
detail: Adjust the rule, export priorities, and review the briefing.
voice: Set a probability threshold to sort unions into action tiers. Export the list or draft a briefing for review.

title: BANGLA + ENGLISH.
detail: A language switch built into the map, panels, and exports.
voice: Switch to Bangla for the forecast map and source panel. Historical exports also support both languages.

title: ESTIMATE WITH EVIDENCE.
detail: Fresh observations → Kalman filter → position and uncertainty
voice: A Kalman filter updates position and motion as new fixes arrive. Between fresh fixes, it estimates motion and tracks uncertainty. Open Meteo supplies the separate regional weather model.

title: TRAIN. TEST. COMPARE.
detail: Leave-one-storm-out isotonic regression · six historical storms
voice: We train an isotonic regression calibrator, leaving each test storm out of training. Calibration did not consistently improve the model-based backtest, so the replay displays raw ensemble probabilities.

title: TEST IT WITH RESPONSE TEAMS.
detail: Proposed pilot with coastal disaster management teams.
voice: Our proposed pilot measures time to a reviewable priority list and whether users recognise stale fixes. Results will guide validation and future shelter and flood layers.

title: BUILT IN BANGLADESH.
detail: International AI Builders Congress · ClimateSphere AI / Climate Shield
voice: We’re Asim, Tawrat, Fahmida, and Shohidur. We’re looking for local teams to help evaluate Ghurni.

title: FROM FORECAST TO ACTION.
voice: Ghoorni. From forecast to action. Follow official warnings.
